radio.m25.p4.beat.heard: Second wave with raiders coming round behind. Hold the beach.

radio.m25.p5.beat.heard: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.

radio.m25.p6.beat.heard: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.

radio.m25.p6.chatter1.heard: West exit answering, waiting for the eastern squad.

radio.m26.p1.beat.heard: Wing splits, four ahead. The rest will come round behind.

radio.m26.p1.group1.heard: Second flight on your six. Turn.

radio.m26.p2.beat.heard: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.

radio.m26.p2.chatter1.heard: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.

radio.m26.p3.beat.heard: He'll be where he can hear himself: the parliament mast.

radio.m26.p3.chatter1.heard: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.

radio.m26.p3.chatter2.heard: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.

radio.m26.p4.beat.heard: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.

radio.m26.p4.chatter1.heard: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.

radio.m26.p5.beat.heard: Secure the key while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.

radio.m26.p5.chatter1.heard: Witnesses boarding. Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.

radio.m26.p6.beat.heard: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until Parliament is in sight.

radio.m26.p6.chatter1.heard: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.

radio.m27.p2.beat.heard: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.

radio.m27.p2.twist.heard: You cut one relay, every loyal pilot still hears me. On me now.

radio.m27.p2.t1.beat.heard: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.

radio.m27.p3.beat.heard: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.

radio.m27.p3.chatter1.heard: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.

radio.m27.p4.beat.heard: That's his jet, Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.

radio.m27.p5.beat.heard: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.

radio.m27.p5.chatter1.heard: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.

radio.m27.p6.beat.heard: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.

radio.m27.p6.chatter1.heard: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.

radio.m27.ace.stage1.heard: Every relay says, "I am the law." Yours is a child's radio. Wing.

radio.m27.ace.stage2.heard: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.

radio.m27.ace.return1.heard: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.

radio.m27.ace.return2.heard: Then hear it from me head on.

radio.m27.ace.call2.heard: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m27.ace.call3.heard: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Three inbound.

story.c00.b00.heard: Two taps. That's me. If you're hearing this, I missed a check-in, and you're sitting in my chair because nobody else wanted the paperwork.

story.c00.b01.heard: He missed three. He told me once, one check-in is weather, two is trouble, three is worry. I've been worried since Tuesday.

story.c00.b02.heard: Sparrow, you fly the pattern too low and too fast, and I never fixed it because it's the only thing you do without asking permission.

story.c00.b03.heard: Command calls it desertion. They made me say the word on the net. I said it. I'm not saying it again.

story.c00.b04.heard: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.

story.c00.b05.heard: Three bandits on the rim and an empty chair. Fine, I'll fly the pattern.

story.c01.b00.heard: The bandits wore our markings, our paint, our numbers. One of them was a tail I cleared for departure in March.

story.c01.b01.heard: The quartermaster found a case under Teal's bunk, a coffee tin, twelve tapes, and a note. For Sara, not for the net.

story.c01.b02.heard: Keep these off the command net. Somebody up there is listening and signing things they shouldn't. If I go quiet, the case goes to Sara, only Sara.

story.c01.b03.heard: There's a manifest in the tin. Aviation fuel shipped as grain to five quays on Iron Coast. Nobody ships grain in drums.

story.c01.b04.heard: Iron Coast is a hundred miles of our own shoreline. Whoever this is, they're not invading. They're already home.

story.c01.b05.heard: Then I'll go and look at the quays myself.

story.c02.b00.heard: I came home through the western switchback, not the pretty way, the way you take when you don't want to be seen coming home.

story.c02.b01.heard: I dropped beacons on the way in, low power, my own frequency. If anyone ever follows me, I wanted it to be someone who knew the song.

story.c02.b02.heard: Recovery wanted to walk the canyon for him. Command said no. There are scouts in the rocks, and recovery teams don't carry missiles.

story.c02.b03.heard: He used to tune that canyon on Sundays, said it was the only place the tower couldn't talk to him.

story.c02.b04.heard: Recovery can reach his receiver if you mark it and stay on their frequency. Finding him is work we can do together.

story.c02.b05.heard: Then that's where he went when he had something to say.

story.c03.b00.heard: Recovery got into the lower switchback. They found his receiver in the rocks. Cracked case, memory intact. He put it where it would be found.

story.c03.b01.heard: There's a radar inside our own training box, dug into the bowl north of the pass. Nobody signed for it. I checked the ledger three times.

story.c03.b02.heard: Somebody wanted to watch trainees, not the sky. Trainees. Think about why you'd want to know when the kids fly.

story.c03.b03.heard: If it's real, it's been watching every pattern you've flown for a year. Command wants it gone quietly. I want it photographed first.

story.c03.b04.heard: The staff list has to reach Varda after the strike. An erased radar can still leave a record nobody can explain away.

story.c03.b05.heard: If I just blow it up, it's a rumor. If I look at it first, it's a crime.

story.c04.b00.heard: The Techland farmers let me hide a tape in a seed tin. The old woman asked my name, not my rank. Nobody at Varda has asked my name in ten years.

story.c04.b01.heard: The radar's memory names that orchard. Three days later, somebody ordered it evacuated. Now there are patrols firing on the evacuation trucks.

story.c04.b02.heard: They're not shooting at farmers. They're shooting at a seed tin. That's how badly someone wants Teal's tape back.

story.c04.b03.heard: Three officers at Varda are being reassigned tonight. Their names are already off the roster. Nobody will ask. Nobody ever asks.

story.c04.b04.heard: Count the trucks again at the road. I want names for the beds at Varda, not a report that says most of them got out.

story.c04.b05.heard: Those trucks are carrying somebody who asked his name. They get out.

story.c05.b00.heard: The convoy made it. The old woman's granddaughter drove the lead truck. She marked three silos on the map with her thumb. Those smell wrong.

story.c05.b01.heard: Three tanks under grain permits, aviation fuel. The farmers know the difference. They just can't prove it. A fuel ledger would prove it.

story.c05.b02.heard: Sparrow, every unmarked silo in that valley is somebody's winter. Don't be the one who makes them hungry to make a point.

story.c05.b03.heard: He wrote that one for you. He never wrote anything for me. I'm choosing not to be hurt by that today.

story.c05.b04.heard: The farm crew can read the ledger over your radio once the patrol is gone. Fuel burns. The names on the page must survive it.

story.c05.b05.heard: Three thumbprints, three fires, nothing else.

story.c06.b00.heard: One courier flies the frequency book through the dust pass every evening. Same time, same whine in the engine. Somebody should fix that bearing.

story.c06.b01.heard: We pulled his escort code out of the silo radios. Five fighters hide in the dust front with him. They'd rather lose him than drop what he carries.

story.c06.b02.heard: If the book is real, every relay on the plateau is in it, every forged voice, every name.

story.c06.b03.heard: Scan the clearings before you chase, then read me the packet on a clean channel. I want its words before command can rewrite them.

story.c06.b04.heard: Then I'd like to read it.

story.c07.b00.heard: Not a frequency book. Tomorrow's orders. Varda Tower compromised. The challenge code changed. My crew relieved at oh-four-hundred.

story.c07.b01.heard: If they ever call our tower compromised, check who changed the challenge code. The tower doesn't go bad. The code does.

story.c07.b02.heard: They've moved it up. They know we have the packet. Two flights are inbound, and my crew is in the tower with a soldering iron and the old code on a napkin.

story.c07.b03.heard: I'm staying in the tower, in case you were wondering. I'm not leaving my chair for them.

story.c07.b04.heard: Spotters are using the apron smoke. Mark the dishes first and stay until our own flights answer the restored tower code.

story.c07.b05.heard: Keep the lights on, Sara. I'll keep the sky.
story.c07.b05.acceptedBecause: Homophone: invented name 'Sera' transcribed as 'Sara'; every word spoken.

story.c08.b00.heard: The tower is ours again. The old code went out at oh-three-fifty-three, and three flights turned around on hearing it. One didn't.

story.c08.b01.heard: Vulture lead followed me into the pass. He wasn't chasing a deserter. You don't chase deserters at night with your lights off. He was erasing a witness.

story.c08.b02.heard: He talks on the guard channel when he's hunting, likes you to know. Don't answer him. Let the canyon answer.

story.c08.b03.heard: He's searching the night approach for you now. Same lights off, same voice. He thinks he's finishing a job.

story.c08.b04.heard: He carries a recorder. Mark where it falls. Recovery should come home with more than another empty aircraft.

story.c09.b00.heard: Vulture lead is down. His recorder survived. He carried relayed emergency orders, dozens, every one signed by a governor who's been dead since spring.

story.c09.b01.heard: Kiro talks to Lira. Lira talks to Meril. Meril talks to the harbors. Break one link and listen to who screams.

story.c09.b02.heard: Kiro keeps an archive. Every forged order filed because forgers are vain. It's the only honest thing on the plateau.

story.c09.b03.heard: I wiped his name off my board this morning, then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.

story.c09.b04.heard: Copy the archive before cutting Kiro. If a hidden radar answers, listen to its command channel until we can find it.

story.c09.b05.heard: I'd like to know what he saw.

story.c10.b00.heard: Declare the emergency first, find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.

story.c10.b01.heard: Kiro's archive survived. We have his signing key, but a key alone is a rumor. We need two more stations' logs with the same signature.

story.c10.b02.heard: Lira and Miral sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Miral repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.

story.c10.b03.heard: Three logs, one signature. If his words go out from the west ridge, they reach the people who hid him.

story.c10.b04.heard: The north farm road has beacons the farmers maintain themselves. If another dish wakes up, that is how you reach it.

story.c10.b05.heard: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.

story.c11.b00.heard: Your packet reached the farms. The old woman heard it in her kitchen. She says Teal sounded tired. She says he always sounded tired.

story.c11.b01.heard: A loyalist crew has one mobile transmitter on a flatbed. It's the only voice on the plateau that isn't his. They're driving it into the refugee corridor.

story.c11.b02.heard: A transmitter on wheels is harder to silence than a voice in a tower, harder to protect too. Somebody will have to fly very close to a very slow truck.

story.c11.b03.heard: If the truck hears a different order, stop it at the fork. Check the mill road, test its new link, and bring the relief crew in.

story.c11.b04.heard: Slow truck, fast jet. I've done worse maths.

story.c12.b00.heard: The transmitter is through. Its first reply named four fuel silos and a relay on a farm with a rail siding and no animals.

story.c12.b01.heard: They call it a farm because a fuel ledger would show the number of aircraft. The silos with no dust on the ladders, those are the ones.

story.c12.b02.heard: There are real houses in that yard, families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.

story.c12.b03.heard: The rail crew can copy the fuel ledger while you fly. Stay for their handoff. A burning tank cannot testify, but its ledger can.

story.c12.b04.heard: Four tanks and a dish. I can count to five.

story.c13.b00.heard: There's a saddle where all three arrays can hear you at once. Go and say something true there. Nobody's said anything true on that frequency in a long time.

story.c13.b01.heard: The staging raid exposed a command frequency. It only reaches the saddle, and the antennas up there are his.

story.c13.b02.heard: Teal flew that saddle on his check ride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.

story.c13.b03.heard: A truck with a dish can replace a dead antenna. Look along the saddle road before we call the chain silent.

story.c13.b04.heard: Then I'll fly his check ride for him, properly this time.

story.c14.b00.heard: Three stations, one signature. The mobile crew has it on tape with the real governor's death certificate read over the top. It runs thirty-five seconds.

story.c14.b01.heard: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds, and a hero is beside the point.

story.c14.b02.heard: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished, thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.

story.c14.b03.heard: When the garrisons answer, follow their beacons and look for parked aircraft. A reply on the radio is not yet a promise kept.

story.c14.b04.heard: Thirty-five seconds. Nobody jams me for thirty-five seconds.

story.c15.b00.heard: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down, and then the marshal answered.

story.c15.b01.heard: Varda Rhykke has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Tecklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.

story.c15.b02.heard: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.

story.c15.b03.heard: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.

story.c15.b04.heard: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders or fuel or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.

story.c15.b05.heard: Rain hides the last fuel markings. Look first, then stay to copy the relay's final traffic while the farm crew gets clear.

story.c15.b06.heard: Then he's moving now, under the weather, and I'm going to be under it with him.

story.c16.b00.heard: His plateau fuel is gone. One relay still talks, the crown station under the aurora. It only transmits at night.

story.c16.b01.heard: At the crown station, I left the order that started all of this, the first one, with his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.

story.c16.b02.heard: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.

story.c16.b03.heard: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud to a tape and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.

story.c16.b04.heard: If the archive jams, look under the array. We bring home the whole signature this time, even if we have to receive it twice.

story.c16.b05.heard: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.

story.c17.b00.heard: Archive recovered. Order zero zero zero one: declare regional emergency, suspend Parliament, assume air command. Signed Rusk, Air Marshal.

story.c17.b01.heard: Rusk, he gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.

story.c17.b02.heard: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try from that ridge. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.

story.c17.b03.heard: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him, loudly.

story.c17.b04.heard: He's challenged your call sign from the ridge, searchlights. He wants you to climb into them. He wants to see your face.

story.c17.b05.heard: Mark a ridge pickup site before you meet him. If he ejects, the Marines need time. The coast needs his testimony after that.

story.c18.b00.heard: Vulture Two is down. He ejected. Marines lifted him off the ridge. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.

story.c18.b01.heard: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine, all of it. I'm done lying to pilots.

story.c18.b02.heard: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.

story.c18.b03.heard: Three warehouses on the military keys, two blocks from a fish market. Rusk put his war where he knew we'd hesitate.

story.c18.b04.heard: Workers are still on those keys. Trace their launch a clear lane and stay for the rescue count after the stores burn.

story.c18.b05.heard: He's right. I'll hesitate, then I'll aim.

story.c19.b00.heard: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels in a boat. It's in the harbor master's safe, and she doesn't like the marshal either.

story.c19.b01.heard: The harbor stores are gone. The harbor master has the copy on a courier launch. The eastern wing has the harbor mouth sealed.

story.c19.b02.heard: Everything we have is on that boat, the archive, the signatures, his tapes. If it sinks, Teal is a deserter forever.

story.c19.b03.heard: Check the exit before the launch moves, then stay until the patrol boat confirms the case has changed hands at sea.

story.c20.b00.heard: The launch is clear. Marines have the evidence, and the city still hears nothing but him.

story.c20.b01.heard: Citizens, Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbor. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.

story.c20.b02.heard: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.

story.c20.b03.heard: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.

story.c20.b04.heard: Find the dish above the apartments before firing. Our repair crew is waiting in a launch to bring the district back afterwards.

story.c20.b05.heard: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.

story.c21.b00.heard: The city heard silence last night, first time since spring. People opened their windows. Then the fog came in, and he started fueling.

story.c21.b01.heard: The reserve fuel has five piers. Each one has a civilian permit, and every permit has the same signature. He never learned a second name.

story.c21.b02.heard: Trainee, I knew Teal. He flew my wing the winter the coast starved while Parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the canyon how far it got him.

story.c21.b03.heard: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.

story.c21.b04.heard: An inspection launch will follow you through the fog. Let its crew check the hoses, then show us the last two piers are dry.

story.c21.b05.heard: He flew your wing, then you hunted him at night with your lights off. I'll remember both.

story.c22.b00.heard: His convoy can't refuel. Three loyalist frigates have ringed the offshore platform. The command frigate carries a green beacon and most of our hope.

story.c22.b01.heard: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.

story.c22.b02.heard: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony too. Half this coast was. Rusk forgot that we all remember.

story.c22.b03.heard: Check the last gap and cover the inspection launch across it. The landing force is waiting for a ring we have actually checked.

story.c22.b04.heard: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.

story.c23.b00.heard: The frigate held. He's pulling his flag off the platform tonight and leaving his reserves on the deck. He's running, and he's leaving the fuel behind.

story.c23.b01.heard: Those stores were never on a defense map. You don't hide fuel at sea for a week, only for a war.

story.c23.b02.heard: Three stores on a trident of decks under a storm he didn't order. There's no high approach left, only the sea.

story.c23.b03.heard: A tanker is still on the platform, and workers are still on the deck. Stop the fuel leaving, then bring the rescue launch clear.

story.c23.b04.heard: He said the canyon got Teal. Let's see what the sea does to him.

story.c24.b00.heard: The platform is dry. Loyalist landing craft are off the city beach, waiting for first light. Parliament is coming home by boat.

story.c24.b01.heard: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.

story.c24.b02.heard: He recorded that one at 2:00 in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.

story.c24.b03.heard: Check both beach exits between the attacks. Stay on the landing channel until both squads answer from the streets.

story.c24.b04.heard: Beneath them. Right. The beach then.

story.c25.b00.heard: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.

story.c25.b01.acceptedBecause: Number formatting: spoken 'Recorder seven-T. Entry oh-four-twelve.' transcribed as digits '7T, entry 0412'.

story.c25.b02.heard: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail, and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.

story.c25.b03.heard: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.

story.c25.b04.heard: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will-

story.c25.b05.heard: He bought those trucks ten minutes. Witnesses are boarding for Parliament tonight. Keep their key and launch safe so they can say what he did.

story.c25.b06.heard: I've amended the record myself. Aircraft lost with pilot, killed, not deserted. Command can court-martial the paperwork.

story.c25.b07.heard: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.

story.c26.b00.heard: The wing is broken. Your triangulation puts his last transmission above the Parliament tower. He's alone up there with one relay and his own voice.

story.c26.b01.heard: Trainee, land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.

story.c26.b02.heard: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.

story.c26.b03.heard: I've got every harbor on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign, not his, yours.

story.c26.b04.heard: Mark a clear road for Rusk before the duel. Then climb Teal's beacon line and stay on the air until every harbor hears you.

story.c26.b05.heard: Marshal, I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.

story.c26.b06.heard: Sarah, Varda trainee, checking in, one of three. The other two are for after.

story.c27.b00.heard: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbor on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.

story.c27.b01.heard: This is Varda trainee transmitting in the clear. The air marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.

story.c27.b02.heard: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.

story.c27.b03.heard: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal, for the Rim, we are coming home.

story.c27.b04.heard: Varda trainee, Varda control, check-in received, two of three. Come home and make the third in person.

story.c27.b05.heard: The sky will still be there.

story.c27.b06.heard: Varda Rim roster. Teal, killed in action, not deserted. Instructor's chair filled.

radio.m01.p1.beat.heard: Turn, then pitch, three seconds each. Feel how she answers.

radio.m01.p2.beat.heard: Cycle targets. Mark the practice radar.

radio.m01.p3.beat.heard: Nose on it. Hold the lock, then fire.

radio.m01.p4.beat.heard: Good hit. Three bandits inbound. Keep them off the field.

radio.m02.p1.beat.heard: Three bandits over the harbor. Take them.

radio.m02.p2.beat.heard: Five warehouses feed the raid. Burn them all.

radio.m02.p3.beat.heard: Their lead is armored. Make every shot count.

radio.m03.p1.chatter1.heard: Third beacon's the one I nearly missed.

radio.m03.p2.beat.heard: Scan below the beacons. Recovery needs the receiver marked.

radio.m03.p2.chatter1.heard: Receiver echo below the second beacon. Keep scanning.

radio.m03.p3.beat.heard: Two scouts shadowing the rim. Clear the pair.

radio.m03.p4.beat.heard: Under three-twenty along the river. Stay out of sight.

radio.m03.p4.chatter1.heard: Bravo flight is hunting the river. Last gate, then turn.

radio.m03.p5.beat.heard: Bravo flight breaking cover. Three in two groups. Clear them.

radio.m03.p6.beat.heard: We have your mark. Keep the link open while we reach it.

radio.m03.p6.chatter1.heard: Receiver in sight. We are climbing down now.

radio.m04.p1.beat.heard: All Varda units stand down. Authority, Air Marshal.

radio.m04.p1.chatter1.heard: Stand down? Nobody at Varda issued that.

radio.m04.p2.beat.heard: Proof's recorded, now kill the radar.

radio.m04.p3.beat.heard: Evidence copied. Follow the service road clear.

radio.m04.p3.chatter1.heard: Road is clear ahead. Keep to the beacon line.

radio.m04.p4.beat.heard: They scrambled a flight. Five in two groups. Hold the line.

radio.m04.p5.beat.heard: Varda is copying the names. Hold the link.

radio.m04.p5.chatter1.heard: First two names copied. Send the third.

radio.m05.p1.beat.heard: Truck's rolling. Please stay with us.

radio.m05.p1.chatter1.heard: Second flight off the ridge. Turn back now.

radio.m05.p1.chatter2.heard: The road's in sight. Don't leave us yet.

radio.m05.p2.beat.heard: Trucks are clear. Their patrol leads are turning in. Three.

radio.m05.p3.beat.heard: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.

radio.m05.p3.chatter1.heard: One bend clear. Check behind the orchard wall too.

radio.m05.p4.beat.heard: All trucks counted. Hold the link for the family's names.

radio.m05.p4.chatter1.heard: Names copied. Finding beds for the children now.

radio.m05.p5.beat.heard: Seed tin is aboard. Follow our homeward beacons.

radio.m05.p5.chatter1.heard: The lead truck sees your lights. Keep leading.

radio.m06.p1.beat.heard: Follow the channel. The marked tanks sit at its end.

radio.m06.p1.chatter1.heard: The unmarked roofs are ours. Please.

radio.m06.p2.beat.heard: Low pass first. Mark the military silos, not the farmhouses.

radio.m06.p2.chatter1.heard: Fuel grade grain in all three. The roofs are clean.

radio.m06.p3.beat.heard: Marked silos only. That grain is fuel.

radio.m06.p4.beat.heard: Five answering the smoke in two groups. Turn into them.

radio.m06.p5.beat.heard: The farm crew found the ledger. Hold the link while they read it.

radio.m06.p5.chatter1.heard: Three fuel shipments, all signed by the same officer.

radio.m07.p1.beat.heard: The courier runs under the dust. Stay in it.

radio.m07.p1.chatter1.heard: Five escorts ahead of him. Dust is thinning.

radio.m07.p2.beat.heard: Scan both clearings for his engine trail.

radio.m07.p2.chatter1.heard: Engine trail at the second clearing. Keep low.

radio.m07.p3.beat.heard: Five escorts in the dust in two groups. Strip them off him.

radio.m07.p4.beat.heard: There's the courier running north. Ninety seconds. Catch him.

radio.m07.p4.chatter1.heard: He's halfway to the plateau. Close on him.

radio.m07.p4.chatter2.heard: Twenty seconds and he's over the edge.

radio.m07.p5.beat.heard: Packet recovered. Head for Varda while I read the orders.

radio.m07.p5.chatter1.heard: Tomorrow's orders copied. Reading the signatures next.

radio.m08.p1.beat.heard: Tower crew resetting the code. Keep the raiders off them.

radio.m08.p1.chatter1.heard: Varda tower is in rebel hands. Fire on it.

radio.m08.p1.chatter3.heard: Second wave's dropping smoke on the apron. Spotters.

radio.m08.p2.beat.heard: Smoke on the apron. Scan for the two spotter dishes first.

radio.m08.p2.chatter1.heard: Two dishes in the smoke. Keep the parked trainers clear.

radio.m08.p3.beat.heard: Code is ours. Two spotter radars on the apron. Hit them.

radio.m08.p4.beat.heard: Spotters down. Their flight is running. Catch three.

radio.m08.p5.beat.heard: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.

radio.m08.p5.chatter1.heard: Loyal flight answering. Waiting on the last one.

radio.m09.p1.beat.heard: The approach lights are his bait. Fly them anyway.

radio.m09.p1.chatter1.heard: Teal flew this line too. Keep coming.

radio.m09.p2.beat.heard: His voice is bouncing off the pass. Scan low to mark the source.

radio.m09.p2.chatter1.heard: Guard channel source above the pass. That is him.

radio.m09.p3.beat.heard: Three on night vision in two groups. Watch your horizon.

radio.m09.p4.beat.heard: Patrol is gone. Hold the channel open. He will come to answer.

radio.m09.p4.chatter1.heard: You have my attention, trainee. Stay there.

radio.m09.p5.beat.heard: Vulture lead. He erased the witness, not you.

radio.m09.p6.beat.heard: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.

radio.m09.p6.chatter1.heard: Recorder ping is steady. Mark the second slope.

radio.m09.ace.stage1.heard: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.

radio.m09.ace.return1.heard: Vulture lead's turning back in. Nose on him.

radio.m09.ace.return2.heard: Head on, trainee, like he did.

radio.m09.ace.call1.heard: Vulture lead pulled back to call his wing. One inbound.

radio.m09.ace.call2.heard: Vulture lead pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m10.p1.beat.heard: Scan the archive first. The dish can wait.

radio.m10.p1.chatter1.heard: Signatures copying. Stay low. Hold fire.

radio.m10.p1.twist.heard: They've seen you. Four climbing off the camp. Scan's on hold.

radio.m10.p1.t1.beat.heard: Four off the camp in pairs. Clear them, then we finish the scan.

radio.m10.p1.t2.beat.heard: Back on the archive. Eight seconds of clean copy.

radio.m10.p1.t2.chatter1.heard: Copy complete in four. Hold your line.

radio.m10.p2.twist.heard: Radar is directing them. Hold the channel. We will trace it.

radio.m10.p2.t1.beat.heard: Hold the channel while we trace the camp radar.

radio.m10.p2.t1.chatter1.heard: The radar is still directing them. Trace is closing.

radio.m10.p2.t2.beat.heard: Radar on the camp roof. Its raiders fire twice as fast. Kill it.

radio.m10.p3.beat.heard: Radar's dead. The response is flying blind. Three.

radio.m11.p2.beat.heard: Alert flight airborne. Three, clear them.

radio.m11.p3.twist.heard: Third dish lit north of the belt. Node Sable, not on the tin.

radio.m11.p3.t1.beat.heard: Farm road north. Two beacons to Sable.

radio.m11.p3.t1.chatter1.heard: That dish went up last week. Nobody asked us.

radio.m11.p3.t2.beat.heard: Sable, dish only. The barn beside it is ours.

radio.m11.p4.beat.heard: Relaying Teal's packet. Ninety seconds. Hold the ridge orbit.

radio.m11.p4.chatter1.heard: We're hearing it. Keep it coming.

radio.m11.p4.chatter2.heard: Last of the packet. Don't drift off the ridge.

radio.m12.p1.beat.heard: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.

radio.m12.p1.chatter1.heard: Second flight coming for the truck.

radio.m12.p1.twist.heard: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.

radio.m12.p1.t1.beat.heard: Ignore him. North is mined. Truck, stop. Scan the mill road.

radio.m12.p1.t1.chatter1.heard: Refugees clear of the bend. One more look at the road.

radio.m12.p1.t2.beat.heard: Mill road is clear. Truck, swing east. We will cover you.

radio.m12.p1.t2.chatter1.heard: Mill road's rough, but we're moving. Stay with us.

radio.m12.p2.beat.heard: Truck's clear. Patrol escalating. Six in two groups.

radio.m12.p3.beat.heard: Parked and transmitting. Hold for our first reply.

radio.m12.p3.chatter1.heard: First loyalist cell answering. Holding for the second.

radio.m12.p4.beat.heard: Relief crew following your beacons. Bring them to the truck.

radio.m12.p4.chatter1.heard: Relief crew sees the transmitter. Last beacon ahead.

radio.m13.p1.beat.heard: Rail spur runs straight to their stores. Follow it.

radio.m13.p1.chatter1.heard: Spur ends at the silos. Low and quiet now.

radio.m13.p2.beat.heard: Mark the stores. Civilian roofs stay standing.

radio.m13.p2.chatter1.heard: Fuel ledger confirmed. Those silos are military.

radio.m13.p3.twist.heard: Four off the plateau. Finish the silos, then turn into them.

radio.m13.p3.t1.beat.heard: Silos burning. Now the four in pairs. Turn in.

radio.m13.p4.beat.heard: The relay's still calling for help. Cut it.

radio.m13.p5.beat.heard: Raiders off the plateau. Three more with hangers on.

radio.m13.p6.beat.heard: Rail crew has the ledger. Hold the link to the cells.

radio.m13.p6.chatter1.heard: Rail ledger copied. Matching it against Kiro's orders.

radio.m14.p1.beat.heard: Saddle beacons lead to the arrays. Climb.

radio.m14.p1.chatter1.heard: All three arrays can hear you now.

radio.m14.p1.chatter2.heard: Unknown aircraft on the saddle. Intercept.

radio.m14.p2.beat.heard: Three dishes on the ridge. Blind them.

radio.m14.p2.twist.heard: Replacement mast on the saddle road. Cut that one too.

radio.m14.p2.t1.beat.heard: Scan the saddle road. They have raised a replacement dish.

radio.m14.p2.t1.chatter1.heard: Dish truck on the saddle road. Civilian vans are clear.

radio.m14.p2.t2.beat.heard: Mast located on the saddle road. Hit the dish.

radio.m14.p3.beat.heard: Perimeter cap turning in. Four in pairs with raiders.

radio.m14.p4.beat.heard: Hold the saddle. I'm listening for anything left alive.

radio.m14.p4.chatter1.heard: More off the dark end of the row. Hold the orbit.

radio.m14.p4.chatter2.heard: Nothing on the chain. Almost there

radio.m15.p1.beat.heard: Transmitting. Every second is a garrison

radio.m15.p1.chatter1.heard: Raiders inbound. Stay inside the volume

radio.m15.p1.hazard.heard: Link lost. Kill the two jammer trucks on the farm road

radio.m15.p2.beat.heard: Second wave riding harder. Seven in two groups. Raiders in tow

radio.m15.p3.beat.heard: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.

radio.m15.p3.chatter1.heard: West garrison beacon confirmed. East is ahead

radio.m15.p4.beat.heard: Scan both compounds for parked aircraft. Verify they stood down.

radio.m15.p4.chatter1.heard: Engines cold at the first compound. Check the second.

radio.m16.p1.beat.heard: River gates keep you under the storm. Stay low.

radio.m16.p1.chatter1.heard: Last gate, the marked tanks are just past it.

radio.m16.p2.beat.heard: Rain hides the markings. Scan both ends before you fire.

radio.m16.p2.chatter1.heard: Fuel markings visible. Keep the farm roofs out of the strike.

radio.m16.p3.beat.heard: Three silos under the storm. Burn them.

radio.m16.p3.twist.heard: Five diving through the cloud. Finish the tanks and turn.

radio.m16.p3.t1.beat.heard: Patrol riding the thunder. Five in two groups.

radio.m16.p4.beat.heard: Forward relay on the staging path. Cut it.

radio.m16.p5.beat.heard: Hold over the relay. Its last traffic is still in the air.

radio.m16.p5.chatter1.heard: Pair off the plateau using the storm. Hold the orbit.

radio.m16.p5.chatter2.heard: Second pair coming out of the rain.

radio.m17.p1.beat.heard: One dish under the aurora. Cut it.

radio.m17.p2.beat.heard: Four intercepts lit by the aurora in pairs

radio.m17.p3.beat.heard: If you hear this up here, read the signature

radio.m17.p3.chatter1.heard: The archive is speaking. Signature decoding.

radio.m17.p3.twist.heard: Archive lost. Jammer under the array. Find it low.

radio.m17.p3.t1.beat.heard: Get under the aurora glow. It'll show on the scan.

radio.m17.p3.t1.chatter1.heard: There, a dish truck in the array's shadow.

radio.m17.p3.t4.beat.heard: Archive's back. Hold the orbit. Read the signature.

radio.m17.p3.t4.chatter1.heard: Signature decoding. Hold. It carries a marshal's seal

radio.m18.p1.chatter1.heard: Teal climbed faster. Show me more

radio.m18.p2.beat.heard: Mark a clear pickup site. We need his answers alive.

radio.m18.p2.chatter1.heard: Ridge landing zone clear. We can bring a helo there

radio.m18.p3.beat.heard: His wingman first, four in pairs.

radio.m18.p4.beat.heard: He flies like Teal. Teal learned it from him.

radio.m18.p4.twist.heard: Chute open. His wing is turning back. Cover the marine's pickup

radio.m18.p4.t1.beat.heard: We have him. Forty-five seconds to get him off the ridge

radio.m18.p4.t1.chatter1.heard: His second pair is diving on the pickup. Hold them

radio.m18.p5.beat.heard: He is talking. Coast is recording. Hold the link.

radio.m18.p5.chatter1.heard: He admits the handwriting. Coast is recording every word

radio.m18.ace.stage1.heard: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.

radio.m18.ace.stage2.heard: Last lesson. Wing, keep him busy.

radio.m18.ace.return1.heard: Now again, trainee, from the top.

radio.m18.ace.return2.heard: Head on, the way Teal never would

radio.m18.ace.call1.heard: Vulture Two pulled back to call his wing. One inbound.

radio.m18.ace.call2.heard: Vulture Two pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

radio.m19.p1.beat.heard: Watch what the cranes unload. Mark the keys.

radio.m19.p1.chatter1.heard: Those crates are munitions. The keys are military.

radio.m19.p2.beat.heard: Three military keys. Hit the warehouses.

radio.m19.p2.twist.heard: Early cap pair launching. Finish the key, then turn in.

radio.m19.p2.t1.beat.heard: Early pair off the apron. Clear them

radio.m19.p3.beat.heard: Follow the three key beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.

radio.m19.p3.chatter1.heard: First bend clear. Last beacon marks the open channel.

radio.m19.p4.beat.heard: Workers aboard. Cover our launch clear of the burning keys.

radio.m19.p4.chatter1.heard: All workers counted. Past the worst of the smoke

radio.m19.p5.beat.heard: Main cap off the apron. Four in two groups

radio.m19.p6.beat.heard: Quays clear. Hold the channel while we count our people.

radio.m19.p6.chatter1.heard: First crew answering. Still calling the eastern key

radio.m20.p1.beat.heard: Full wing on the east line. Nine in three groups

radio.m20.p2.beat.heard: Paper is aboard. Scan the harbor exit before we move.

radio.m20.p2.chatter1.heard: Exit marked. We will move as soon as your scan is clear.

radio.m20.p3.beat.heard: Launch moving. Keep the sky quiet

radio.m20.p3.chatter1.heard: Western wing reacting. Launch is halfway out

radio.m20.p3.hazard.heard: Guns on both banks firing on the launch. Silence them

radio.m20.p4.beat.heard: Holding at the exit. Mark the patrol boat's approach beacons.

radio.m20.p4.chatter1.heard: Patrol boat sees your mark. One more beacon.

radio.m20.p5.beat.heard: Patrol boat alongside. Hold until the paper changes hands.

radio.m20.p5.chatter1.heard: Archive case passed. Tapes are next

radio.m21.p1.beat.heard: The dark canal keeps you off his radar. Follow it.

radio.m21.p1.chatter1.heard: Relay above the apartments. Hit only the dish.

radio.m21.p2.beat.heard: Low scan over the canal. Mark the dish above the roofs.

radio.m21.p2.chatter1.heard: Dish marked. Apartment roofs stay standing.

radio.m21.p3.beat.heard: Broadcast relay above the city. Dish only.

radio.m21.p4.beat.heard: Escort flight scrambling. Four in two pairs.

radio.m21.p5.beat.heard: Hold over the tower. I want to hear nothing from it.

radio.m21.p5.chatter1.heard: Pair off the dark side of the city. Hold the orbit.

radio.m21.p6.beat.heard: Repair crew moving. Cover us to the dark district.

radio.m21.p6.chatter1.heard: Crew passing the canal bend. Keep the approach clear.

radio.m21.p7.beat.heard: Launch moored. Follow district lights to guide the shore crew.

radio.m21.p7.chatter1.heard: Shore crew sees your mark. Moving to the next street

radio.m22.p1.beat.heard: The fog depots carry his signature. Find them.

radio.m22.p1.chatter1.heard: Permits match. Every depot is fuel.

radio.m22.p2.beat.heard: Five depots in the fog, all marked.

radio.m22.p3.beat.heard: Follow the pier beacons. Check the whole fuel line is cut.

radio.m22.p3.chatter1.heard: West pier empty. Follow the lights to the east.

radio.m22.p4.beat.heard: Patrol riding the fog. Four in two pairs

radio.m22.p5.beat.heard: Cannot see the piers. Cover us while we check the hoses.

radio.m22.p5.chatter1.heard: Inspectors at the central pier. Fuel line looks dry.

radio.m22.p6.beat.heard: Scan the last two piers. We need proof every hose is dry.

radio.m22.p6.chatter1.heard: First hose disconnected. Check the eastern pier too.

radio.m22.p7.beat.heard: Hoses dry. Hold the link for the frigates to copy

radio.m22.p7.chatter1.heard: Report copied. The escape fleet cannot refuel.

radio.m23.p1.beat.heard: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.

radio.m23.p1.chatter1.heard: Second group off the platform. Hold them.

radio.m23.p1.chatter2.heard: Third group low on the water. Two left in the ring.

radio.m23.p2.beat.heard: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.

radio.m23.p2.chatter1.heard: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.

radio.m23.p3.beat.heard: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four from both sides.

radio.m23.p4.beat.heard: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

radio.m23.p4.chatter1.heard: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.

radio.m23.p5.beat.heard: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.

radio.m23.p5.chatter1.heard: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.

radio.m23.p6.beat.heard: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force

radio.m23.p6.chatter1.heard: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward

radio.m24.p1.beat.heard: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.

radio.m24.p1.chatter1.heard: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.

radio.m24.p2.beat.heard: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.

radio.m24.p3.beat.heard: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five in two groups.

radio.m24.p4.beat.heard: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.

radio.m24.p4.chatter1.heard: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.

radio.m24.p5.beat.heard: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.

radio.m24.p5.chatter1.heard: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.

radio.m24.p5.chatter2.heard: He's almost over the city. Now

radio.m24.p6.beat.heard: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.

radio.m24.p6.chatter1.heard: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.

radio.m24.p7.beat.heard: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.

radio.m24.p7.chatter1.heard: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns

radio.m25.p1.beat.heard: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us

radio.m25.p1.chatter1.heard: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft

radio.m25.p2.beat.heard: First intercept off the apron. Three in two groups

radio.m25.p3.beat.heard: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

radio.m25.p3.chatter1.heard: West exit clear. Check the eastern street
